exposure: indication for induction (oligohydramnios, glucose intolerance, hypertension, premature rupture of membranes, low-risk pregnancy at 40 weeks
cohort: 292 pregnant women requiring delivery in a teaching institute in Chennai, India, with 35.95% requiring labor induction and 27.73% having spontaneous labor.
finding: 50% of induced labors resulted in vaginal delivery compared to 79% of spontaneous labors, with no significant difference in maternal or neonatal complications between the two groups.
mod_finding: Women with unfavorable preinduction Bishop score had higher risk of cesarean delivery in the labor-induced group.
